description: [provider] Search cities by name. Searches cities by name or country codes — returns up to 100 cities per page (CompanyEnrich · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE. Returns numeric city `id`s for the `cities` filter. Expect near-duplicates for one metro ('San Francisco', 'City and County of San Francisco', 'South San Francisco') — pass all the ids you mean, or you will silently narrow the audience.

countryCodes.description: ISO alpha-2 codes to scope the search

query.description: city name; prefixes work ('san fran' matched three San Francisco entries)

name: companyenrich_geo_cities_search
